info.title: SmartLink API
info.description:
# Authentication
To use the API you need to authenticate with a valid api key (Your apiKey is available in Workflow -> api). You must provide the api key in the header **x-api-key** of your requests.

# Rate Limiting

The API implements rate limiting to ensure fair usage and system stability. Rate limits can be configured per organization.

## Rate Limit Headers

Every API response includes the following headers to help you track your usage:

- **X-RateLimit-Limit**: Maximum number of requests allowed in the current time window
- **X-RateLimit-Remaining**: Number of requests remaining in the current time window
- **X-RateLimit-Reset**: Unix timestamp (in milliseconds) when the rate limit will reset

## Rate Limit Exceeded

When you exceed the rate limit, you will receive a **429 Too Many Requests** response with the same headers indicating when you can retry.

# SmartLink SDK

Use our [Javascript SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vaultys/smartlink-sdk) to verify your webhooks and use the SmartLink API.

```bash
npm i @vaultys/smartlink-sdk
```
